candidates.title: Reorder Sign-In After Desktop Home Intro
candidates.change: Move sign-in to the end of onboarding after home_intro so users experience their pet on the desktop before creating an account, ensuring pet ownership state is tied cleanly.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in, and sign-in early in the flow causes friction before users see their pet.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Pet to Your Account
sign_in.body: Link your desktop companion to an account so your progress and custom traits are never lost.

guard.reason: home_intro must come after every existing screen, sign_in included

candidates.title: Desktop Controls & Interaction Guide Screen
candidates.change: Add a new interactive onboarding screen detailing pet hotkeys, desktop tray controls, and voice/chat interaction options.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets highlighted confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion!
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop screen. Let's quickly review how to interact with it.

candidates.why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and 3 support emails reported custom pets failing or looking wrong.

candidates.why: Adoption step dropoff is severe (60.9%) and median time spent is high across onboarding.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Meet Your Companion?

candidates.title: Pet Account Auto-Sync Safety Hint

candidates.why: 8 emails reported pets missing or reset after re-authenticating.

sign_in.hint: Signing in secures your adopted pet so it never disappears across sessions.

candidates.title: Starter Trait Incentive Cards on Pick Friend
candidates.change: Display unlockable starter personality traits and accessories badges directly on pet choices.

candidates.title: Interactive Hatching Progress Indicators on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Show step-by-step creation progress checkmarks and dynamic timer estimates on the waiting screen.
